criteria.criterion: One decidable goal with the scope boundaries stated
Every request item maps to a unit and every unit traces back
Every unit carries a checkable MUST/SHOULD criterion taken from the request
Every MUST criterion names a check that exists today or is updated to one that does
One writer per surface and units ordered by dependency
Unsafe or unresolvable items name the HALT path and the operator question

findings.evidence: the review showed U6's cell cannot pass as written (one verdict file where two rounds exist); the cell now uses the glob form and the gate rejects the old form

claims.claim: The spec is decidable and every request item has a unit
The plan gate is clean against the current spec
